name: reduce
context_rationale: Reduce audits the vault and code graph for structural complexity signals using file inputs and code-review-graph queries; the audit phase is mechanically runnable over file inputs with no main-thread session state required.
summary: Complexity budget enforcer that audits the vault and codebase for over-engineering, dead claims, and speculative generality against mode-specific thresholds. Produces a ranked list of reduction candidates and optionally proposes a simplification slice. Appends a post-reduction lesson to lessons-learned.json after a reduction slice ships. Can be forked as a background subagent on larger codebases.

reads.purpose: Read project mode to apply correct complexity thresholds (Step 1)
Audit ADR count, reference usage, and detect unreferenced/premature ADRs
Read scope to compare against component/ADR counts
God-node detection: read pre-built graph report for highest in/out degree nodes

outputs.purpose: Append over-engineering pattern lesson after reduction slice ships (Step 8)

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: Append over-engineering pattern lesson after reduction slice ships (Step 8, SVW-1/ADR-087)

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.invocation: code-review-graph build|update | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — builds/refreshes the code graph; reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read vault files: triage.json for mode, concept.json for scope, decisions/ADR-*.json for referenced ADRs, component/contract files in Heavy mode

harness_tools.purpose: Check ADR references across vault to identify unreferenced ADRs (grep -r 'ADR-NNN')

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Enumerate vault files for component/contract/ADR counts

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run code-review-graph queries; run git diff for changed-file scoping
